title: Calmness
bodyHtml:
Sometimes, calmness isn’t about changing your life,
it is about remembering a moment.

A quiet beach at sunset.

The smell of the sea.

The colors of the sky.

The stillness within.

Just like a cat who curls up and lets the world pass by,
we too can pause, breathe, and return to a memory of peace.

Because calmness, once known, is never truly lost.
